name: Big Nate
description: Sixth-grader Nate Wright has a never-ending need to prove his awesomeness to the world. Whether he’s dealing with disasters at home or detention at school, Nate is no stranger to a challenge. Luckily, he’s able to express himself through the world of cartoons that he creates. Charming, mischievous and a magnet for misadventure – trouble is always fun when Nate is around.

videos.title: Short: How to Pull a Proper Prank
videos.overview: Nate teaches his fans how to pull wild pranks in all facets of their lives! Pranking on Nate's level isn't for the faint of heart so buckle up and enjoy the ride.

videos.title: Short: Theater Antics
videos.overview: Nate thinks acting is a breeze but when Dee Dee gives him an unassuming part in her play as 'The Seagull,' she coaches Nate into immersing himself fully into the character to show him just how challenging acting can be.

videos.title: Short: The Butt Cheeks Song
videos.overview: When Nate can't sleep, he asks Martin to sing him to sleep with a special lullaby.

videos.title: Short: Spitsy's Barking Lessons
videos.overview: Nate and Teddy attempt to turn Spitsy into a useful guard dog to protect him from bullies like Randy. There is no length they wont travel to inspire a ferocious bark in Spitsy.

videos.title: Short: How To Get Ripped or Die Tryin'
videos.overview: Nate figures out how to pass gym class in an unconventional way with the help of his friends, and it has nothing to do with physical fitness.

videos.title: Short: Locker Makeover Day
videos.overview: It's Locker Makeover Day at P.S. 38. Take a look inside Nate's locker and all the wonders (and pranks) it holds.

videos.title: Short: Picture Day
videos.overview: After too many failed school picture days, Nate decides to take matters into his own hands and break into the yearbook room.

videos.title: The Legend of the Gunting
videos.overview: Nate has multiple detentions on the docket, per usual. But this time he is one detention away from a fate only whispered about in the halls of P.S. 38 AND the unhinged new kid is determined to become Nate’s prank partner.

videos.title: Go Nate, It’s Your Birthday
videos.overview: To remedy Nate’s subpar birthday celebrations, Martin lets Nate borrow his credit card with rules that may have been “open to interpretation”. After a day of limitless fun, Nate and his friends must pay off their debt.

videos.title: Valentine’s Day of Horror
videos.overview: Nate has decided this Valentine’s Day, he will finally profess his love for his dream girl in the form of a grand gesture, but the day of love quickly turns into a nightmare after Nate’s “gift” gives the entire school food poisoning.

videos.title: CATastrophe
videos.overview: When Nate is paired with Jenny on a school project, he hopes to prove his awesomeness to her, but his cat phobia threatens to destroy his cool. Meanwhile, Ellen sets out to cure Martin of a deeply ingrained phobia of his own.

videos.title: The Pimple
videos.overview: Nate gets his first pimple. In a quick turn of events, his blemish is deemed lucky and he blesses P.S. 38 with his zit until one by one, his clients luck turns sour. Meanwhile, Dee Dee gets the theatre teacher of her dreams.

videos.title: Belles A Ringin’
videos.overview: While buying romance novels for a heartbroken Ellen, Nate discovers they are total cash cows. Under a pen name, he writes a best-selling graphic novel using the people in his life as inspiration until it catches up to him.

videos.title: Time Disruptors
videos.overview: A local legend comes to life as Nate and friends prepare for an epic party. But Nate’s awesome plans may be foiled as a mysterious presence stalks the students and Francis disappears for hours at a time over at Jefferson.

videos.title: Wilderness Warriors
videos.overview: While on a school camping trip, Nate is determined to win the Wilderness Warrior Award, Dee Dee uses her acting skills to cope with anxiety, and the teachers hatch a plan to steal an eagle egg.

videos.title: Best Laid Cell Plans
videos.overview: When Francis gets an emergency cell phone, the gang makes major plans for it, but even the best laid cell plans can go wrong.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: When Nate finds himself accidentally responsible for the cancellation of an entire species, he must save a pregnant lizard from the clutches of P.S. 38's latest homeec teacher.

videos.title: 'Til Death Do We Rock
videos.overview: Nate is asked to give up center stage as lead singer of "Fear the Mollusk" for his sworn enemy, but he won't give up that easily and neither will Martin.

videos.title: Randy's Mom Has Got It Going On
videos.overview: Martin's desire to dive into a relationship with Randy's mom blinds him to countless red flags, while Nate struggles to co-exist with maniacal Randy who has now infiltrated every aspect of Nate's life.

videos.title: Ghostly Coven of Man Witches
videos.overview: To dodge a science test, Nate concocts a plan to shut down PS 38 by pretending that it's haunted; as he and his friends set the stage, they get locked in the school with a coven of man witches.

videos.title: The Future Is Fuzzy
videos.overview: Nate hopes to spin a newfound gift into a bright future but soon discovers there's no fast track to success; Dee Dee worries a new actress is stealing her spotlight.

videos.title: The Big Freeze
videos.overview: Nate and Team Awesome face Jefferson in the annual Big Freeze snow sculpture competition.

videos.title: The Curse of the Applewhites
videos.overview: Nate's gym grade is on thin ice and the only thing that can save him from the humiliation of repeating 6th grade gym is something he swore to hate for eternity.

videos.title: The Thing That Wouldn't Leave
videos.overview: Nate and Francis discover the Pope family schedule while on spring break.

videos.title: Kindness Wars
videos.overview: When Artur saves Nate’s life, Nate finds himself deeply indebted to his greatest foe. To even the scales, Nate engages in a war of kindness, unbeknownst to his opponent, Artur. Kim Cressly trains Francis to channel his inner Kim.

videos.title: Wait Until Dark
videos.overview: Nate is ready to be treated like an adult, so when Martin and Ellen head out of town, he insists he can hold down the fort ALONE. But when zombies strike, Nate questions his ability to take on life by himself.

videos.title: The Square Root of Teddy
videos.overview: When P.S. 38 is hit with the dreaded standardized testing, Teddy receives a perfect score and is exposed as a math genius. As Teddy’s success is exploited, Francis struggles with his identity as the smartest kid in sixth grade.

videos.title: Six-Tween Candles
videos.overview: Dee Dee's excited to celebrate her birthday but her friends and family are so wrapped up with trying to surprise her that Dee Dee feels forgotten and winds up spending her special day with a new girl who has just moved to town.

videos.title: It's Lonely at the Top
videos.overview: When Nate's elected Student Safety Sergeant he's wildly unprepared for the responsibility. Meanwhile, Principal Nichols discovers the teachers hang out without him and is desperate to ingratiate himself into their inner circle.

videos.title: Nate in Shining Armor
videos.overview: Nate must convince a 5th grade girl to attend P.S. 38 next year and is sure his awesomeness will do the trick. But Leah has her head stuck in Medieval times and may need to be swayed to the present by her Nate in shining armor.

videos.title: Bro-king Up is Hard to Do
videos.overview: In the thick of Ellen’s recent heartbreak, Nate is apathetic per usual. But when he falls into a bromance with Ellen’s cool new beau, heartache ensues. P.S. 38’s new school anthem may be the only thing to put their pieces back together.

videos.title: Nate on a Hot Tin Roof
videos.overview: Nate has set the P.S. 38 record for most detentions in one month, putting the teachers on "Nate Watch." To dodge this personal purgatory, Nate decides to help Dee Dee put on the school's musical... casting the teachers as the stars.

videos.title: The April Fool
videos.overview: It's April Fools' Day and Nate hopes to pull off an epic prank inspired by his hero, Brad Gunter, but Nichols is all too familiar with Gunter's old tricks.

videos.title: The Curse of Eewcorpico (1)
videos.overview: Nate's grandparents take the Wrights on an ill-fated seafaring adventure to find the rumoured lost treasure of Eewcorpico; Captain Dee Dee leads a rescue mission to save Nate and his family from the treasure's curse.

videos.title: The Curse of Eewcorpico (2)
videos.overview: Nate continues his search for treasure, but the Curse of Ewwcorpico has other plans; washed up on an island, the rest of the crew searches for Nate while getting back to Rackleff safely looks less and less likely by the minute.

videos.title: Mouth Brow Madness
videos.overview: Nate and Teddy go to great lengths to get invited to hang with the cool 7th graders, but they get more than they bargained for when they find out just how much more intense middle school gets after 6th grade.

videos.title: Flavor Blasted Beardy Yum Yums
videos.overview: When Nate's favourite snack releases a flavor-blasted version, he can't wait to get his hands on it and rid P.S. 38 of its old vending machine in the process; when an allergic reaction sends Nate home, he returns to chaos.

videos.title: Bum Rap
videos.overview: Nate is excited when Martin agrees to sub for Godfrey, but his dad's behaviour soon has him longing for her swift return; Dee Dee gets cast in a commercial, but the embarrassing product has her hiding from the spotlight.

videos.title: A Star Is Torn
videos.overview: When Nate and Nolan's ongoing rivalry goes too far, they find themselves in a battle for one of Nate's most treasured possessions, his friendships; Dee Dee's shot at superstardom may just get caught in the crosshairs.

videos.title: Valentine's Day of Horror: Chapter II
videos.overview: Principal Nichols makes the students take a love matchmaking quiz ahead of the Valentine's Day Dance, and Nate tries to rig the outcome to secure Jenny as his date.

videos.title: Nate Wright's Day Off
videos.overview: Nate skips school to enjoy a day on the town with his friends, but his freedom is short-lived when he must team up with Godfrey to get Spitsy to the vet in time for an urgent procedure.

videos.title: Rackleff's G.O.A.T.
videos.overview: Nate hopes to impress Jenny by setting a world record but struggles to find a feat that aligns with his talents; Jenny wants to make it to Artur's big coming-of-age celebration, but her demanding schedule interferes.

videos.title: Ballad of Big Nate
videos.overview: When an esteemed art critic comes to town, Nate hopes to dazzle him; however, his original characters begin to disappear one by one from his mind; Nate and friends explore his imagination to save them with some help from the past.

videos.title: The Real Kids of PS 38
videos.overview: Hoping to put Rackleff on the map, Nate decides to create a reality show set at P.S. 38, but to stay on the air he'll need to subject his friends to a whole lot of drama.

videos.title: Holy Pierogis
videos.overview: Responsible for a grisly bug infestation, Nate resolves to raise money for an exterminator by selling Zora's beloved pierogis. Meanwhile, Martin partners with one of Nate's teachers to take care of the bugs the old-fashioned way.

videos.title: The Tween's Gambit
videos.overview: During the annual 6th grade sleepover, Nate is determined to join the ranks of legendary P.S. 38 pranksters. But his plans are foiled when Randy strangely refuses to let Nate out of his sight.

videos.title: Nate Wright Has Left the Building
videos.overview: When Nate finds out he's moving away he wants the people of Rackleff to remember him fondly; meanwhile, Amy's best friend tells her she's changed since leaving NYC so Amy is determined to prove her wrong.

videos.title: Speed Bump Brawl
videos.overview: When a dispute over a speed bump at school divides the parents, Nate and Francis' friendship is tested. Chad is Kid Principal for the day but must navigate the chaos by himself when Nichols gets put out of commission.

videos.title: NATESgiving
videos.overview: After Ruby invites herself over to witness a famous Wright Family Thanksgiving firsthand, Nate is forced to flip the script, desperate not to scare her off. Dee Dee mines for drama in an otherwise mundane storyline for this year's holiday pageant.

videos.title: Field of Nightmares
videos.overview: When Nate is made captain of the P.S. 38 baseball team only days before the Rackleff County Championship game, he pushes his team too hard on the path to victory; meanwhile Francis conquers a sports related phobia.

videos.title: Exes Machina
videos.overview: Nate is determined to win the EEW Corp science competition so he can snag the grand prize, but he is up against Nolan and his genius friends who have a few tricks up their sleeves. Francis grapples with facing his exes.

videos.title: Scarytale Endings
videos.overview: With a huge haul of Halloween candy on the line, Nate makes a bet with Teddy to prove there's no such thing as ghosts; after Principal Nichols backs into a child's bike, he tries to bury the guilt but it follows him everywhere.

videos.title: Rackleff's a Dump
videos.overview: Nate's excited to collaborate with Ruby on an antitrash art project, but his desperate desire to impress her may get him dumped; meanwhile, Gina and Nichols' single use product addictions spiral out of control.

videos.title: Nate Eat World
videos.overview: When a heartbroken Nate sings at the talent show auditions, it's so well received that he must stay down in the dumps or risk losing the band's success. Dee Dee's lack of painful life experiences impacts a performance.

videos.title: Carlottha the Sloth-a
videos.overview: Nate finds a sloth in his backyard and campaigns for a way to keep her as a pet. Meanwhile, Teddy is suspicious and investigates how an exotic animal randomly showed up in Rackleff.

videos.title: The Unsittable Ones
videos.overview: When Ellen loses her babysitting job to a group of teenage triplets, Nate rallies his friends to bring down this ruthless babysitting monopoly! But to do so, Nate must tap intro the dangerous power of the 'Unsittable One.'

videos.title: Norchaborf
videos.overview: Nate hosts an exchange student who is not quite what Nate has imagined. Amy is excited to join a cooking team but to stay in her group she'll have to lower her culinary standards.

videos.title: Extreme Makeover: Gym Teacher Edition
videos.overview: Nate's given detention for an epic prank, he offers to help Coach John impress his former classmates at a reunion in exchange for a reduced sentence. Gina is horrified to learn she's been voted "most boring" kid in class.

videos.title: Fuller House
videos.overview: Nate enrolls in clown school in hopes of spreading global happiness. After learning Nate's dad forbids Nate from attending, Nate's friends recruit Martin into their bird watching club as a distraction.
